svg.metadata: {"id": "s025", "name": "竹林书院", "cat": "语文与历史", "tags": ["语文", "历史", "传统文化", "古诗"], "desc": "青瓦白墙的书院掩映在层层竹林中，马头墙、匾额与石板路，竹叶随风飘落，适合古诗文与历史课。", "stand": {"ground_y": 900, "x": [600, 1320]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "sky", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "hills", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.15, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "bamboo_far", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.25, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "mist", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.35, "loop": "drift", "depth": null}, {"name": "academy", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.45, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "lanterns", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.9, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "lantern_glow", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "ground", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "stone_lamps", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.7, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "near_bamboo_l", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 0.6, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "near_bamboo_r", "enter": "slide-r", "delay": 0.65, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "falling_leaves", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.2, "loop": "drift", "depth": null}], "palette": {"sky1": "#D7EFE6", "sky2": "#F7F5E8", "hill": "#C4DFD2", "hill2": "#A9CDBB", "wallw": "#F8F5EE", "wallw2": "#E6E1D6", "tile": "#4A5560", "tile2": "#6B7682", "wood": "#8A5A3E", "wood2": "#6B4330", "door": "#7A4632", "plaque": "#2F3A44", "gold": "#E2B860", "bam1": "#CFE6D2", "bam2": "#9CCBA6", "bam3": "#5FA77A", "bam4": "#3E8A60", "stone": "#D9D4C7", "stone2": "#BDB6A6", "path": "#E6DFCE", "grass": "#9ACB8A", "grass2": "#7FB873", "lamp": "#FFE1A0"}}
